answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 38851 Country: NZ Title: Please could you inform me regarding the Arabic meaning of my name Question: Please could you inform me regarding the Arabic meaning of my name? My name is Shameer. I have researched online and found the meanings as such: SHEEN ALIF MEEN YA RA means haseen jawaan (handsome youth). SHEEN MEEM YA RA means mehnati, tajurba kaar (hardworking person). Is the meaning for both correct? If so, can I adopt the first version of my name, which means haseen jawaan? If the meanings are not found, can you propose a better name I could have? Answer ID: 38851 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1014/839/B=1433) We could not find the word Shaameer (شامير) or Shameer (شمير) in Arabic dictionary. However, we did find the word Shammeer (شمِّير) which means hardworking and active. You are advised to keep your name Sameer (سمير) with small seen which means a person who talks, it shall be easy to pronounce and far better. It is hard to pronounce the word Shammeer (شمِّير). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
